name: History File Deletion
description: Detects deletion of a shell history file to remove traces of malicious activity. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_susp_history_delete.yml, hand-converted from Sigma.
query: any where process.executable like~ ("*/rm", "*/unlink", "*/shred") and process.title like~ ("*.bash_history*", "*.zsh_history*", "*_history*")
author: Sentinel
